korean_vocabulary.txt is derived from the Korean 50k list of FrequencyWords by Hermit Dave
(https://github.com/hermitdave/FrequencyWords, content/2018/ko/ko_50k.txt), licensed under
Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0,
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). Changes: the counts were dropped and only
words of two or more Hangul syllables were kept (tools/build_korean_vocabulary.py).
korean_vocabulary.txt itself is distributed under the same license, CC BY-SA 4.0.
